policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.fairness_rule: Actor, reward critic and state-value risk critic architecture/initialization remain exactly as RCWA v4. V5 replaces the single Tail-Q critic with two identically initialized risk-specific scalar action-value critics assigned to disjoint training-weather folds. No extra environment interaction is introduced.

objective.primary: maximize expected water return, equivalently minimize expected controllable postplant irrigation

risk_constraint.grouping: Each eta is estimated independently from exactly 18 equally weighted training weather-year episodes per update.
risk_constraint.tau_estimator: For each eta and update, tau is the empirical lower-alpha quantile: the ceil(alpha*n)-th smallest retention. With n=18 and alpha=0.20 this is the fourth-smallest retention.
risk_constraint.actor_risk_constant_omitted: The eta-tau term is constant with respect to the action distribution when tau is frozen at the batch optimum; by the envelope argument it is omitted from the actor/risk-critic return to avoid score-function variance.
risk_constraint.exact_contract_check: The Rockafellar-Uryasev value at empirical tau must numerically equal the exact fractional order-statistic estimator from awm-risk-contract-v1.

lagrangian.primal_order: Freeze lambda_k, tau_k and all tail assignments for the complete PPO update; update actor/reward critic/risk critic; then update duals to lambda_{k+1}.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.advantage_normalization: standardize reward and tail-risk components before dual weighting; do not standardize the combined advantage after applying lambda
optimizer.risk_advantage_conditioning: standardize A_tail_risk independently within each eta group so collapsed low-retention batches retain directional tail contrast
optimizer.gradient_clipping: clip actor, reward critic, and risk critic parameter groups independently at max_grad_norm=0.5 before the shared Adam step
optimizer.v2_rationale: Preserve exact lower-CVaR/RU semantics while preventing tiny tail-hinge scale, post-combination normalization, random initial risk baseline, and critic spikes from suppressing primal risk response.

tail_credit.episode_tail_cost: h=(1/alpha)*max(tau-R,0), identical to RCWA v1-v4 and frozen after the 54-episode rollout.
tail_credit.risk_value_target: Monte-Carlo complete-episode risk return h_i on every transition (gamma=1), identical to RCWA v4.
tail_credit.risk_critic_prefit: Before actor PPO optimization, fit ONLY global V_tail(s) to frozen MC risk returns on the complete on-policy batch, identical to RCWA v4.
tail_credit.tail_q_definition: Two persistent Q_tail^0(s,a), Q_tail^1(s,a) critics approximate E[h_i|s_t,a_t] from mutually exclusive training-weather folds.
tail_credit.cross_weather_assignment: Sort the frozen 2000-2017 training years and assign alternating years to fold 0/1. Each fold therefore contains exactly 9 years and all three eta cells for those years on every update.
tail_credit.cross_weather_persistence: Q_tail^k is updated only from weather years assigned to fold k for the entire run; it never trains on the opposite fold.
tail_credit.heldout_actor_credit: For a transition from fold 0, use Q_tail^1(s,a); for fold 1, use Q_tail^0(s,a). Thus the action-dependent actor credit for every training weather year is predicted by a critic that has never been optimized on that year.
tail_credit.tail_q_action: Same sampled hierarchical pre-controller action as RCWA v4: gate plus active-only amount_fraction; amount=0 for no-op.
tail_credit.tail_q_output_initialization: Both fold critics start from identical hidden parameters and zero output heads so initial fold asymmetry comes only from training-weather data.
tail_credit.tail_q_target: The unchanged MC episode tail return h_i; no bootstrapping and no new risk label.
tail_credit.tail_q_prefit_learning_rate: optimizer.learning_rate (1e-4). Each transition in its permitted weather fold is revisited for the same 10 epochs as RCWA v4.
tail_credit.coverage_balance: Within each training fold and eta, Q regression reweights the observed behavior actions so every non-empty action stratum has equal total loss mass.
tail_credit.coverage_weight_formula: For eta group size N and K non-empty strata, each sample in stratum k with n_k samples receives weight N/(K*n_k); the mean weight within eta is exactly one.
tail_credit.coverage_rationale: Rare noop/small/large observed actions remain influential in critic fitting without changing the on-policy behavior distribution or fabricating counterfactual rewards.
tail_credit.actor_credit: A_tail=Q_tail^heldout(s_t,a_t)-V_tail(s_t), computed under no_grad after prefits and detached for the complete PPO update.
tail_credit.actor_credit_frozen: Fold Q critics and V_tail are not recomputed for actor credit during PPO minibatch epochs.
tail_credit.main_ppo_q_update: Fold Tail-Q critics receive no gradient during main PPO epochs; only their fold-restricted prefits update them.
tail_credit.no_schedule_prior: No conventional schedule, stage threshold, DAP pacing penalty, reward shaping, validation feedback, dynamic CVaR or extra expected-shortfall objective is introduced.

rollout.risk_assignment_time: after all 54 episodes are collected and before PPO optimization

interaction_budget.fairness_rule: Exactly the same maximum training interaction budget as PPO v1 and PPO-Lagrangian v1; risk estimation and dual updates use only the existing 54 rollout episodes.

change_rule: RCWA v5 is derived from the v4 u60 forensic. Relative to v4, only Tail-Q estimation changes scientifically: two permanent disjoint training-weather critics provide cross-weather held-out action credit, and their observed-action regression is coverage-balanced within eta. Policy sampling, PPO ratios, reward, lower-CVaR/dual semantics, actor/V architectures, interaction budget, weather split, validation protocol, water budget and all agricultural contracts remain unchanged.
